# Cross-platform golden fixtures

These fixtures are copied from the current PowerShell protocol and history
semantics. They are intentionally sanitized and contain no real server data.

- metrics-v2.sample.txt exercises CPU, memory, user attribution, and GPU parsing.
- history-v2.jsonl exercises the version 2 append-only history envelope.
- assets/serverpulse-sample.sh is the canonical LF-only remote sampler.
